meanings.usage: 描述天气好或身体状况好
常与介词 in 搭配使用
与定冠词 the 连用，表示独一无二的事物
英式英语，美式英语为 airplane

examples.en: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky.
Mr. Jones is with his family.
examples.zh: 琼斯先生和家人在一起。

examples.en: They are walking over the bridge.
Sally is looking at a big ship.
examples.zh: 莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。

examples.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

grammar.title: There be 句型
grammar.structure: There is/are + 名词 + 地点
grammar.definition: 表示某地存在某物或某人 表示客观存在的'有'，与 have/has 不同

examples.en: There are some clouds in the sky.
There are some boats on the river.

grammar.title: 现在进行时
grammar.definition: 表示正在发生的动作 描述说话时正在进行的动作

examples.en: They are walking over the bridge.
The ship is going under the bridge.

grammar.title: 方位介词 over 和 under
grammar.definition: over 表示在...上方（不接触），under 表示在...下方 描述物体之间的相对位置关系

examples.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

patterns.pattern: There is/are + 名词 + 介词短语

original.en: There are some clouds in the sky.

imitations.en: There is a book on the table.
There are some students in the classroom.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 动词-ing + 介词短语

original.en: The ship is going under the bridge.

imitations.en: The birds are flying over the trees.
The children are playing in the park.
imitations.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are looking at + 名词

original.en: Sally is looking at a big ship.
original.zh: 莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。

imitations.en: He is looking at the picture.
They are looking at the airplane.

translations.33:
今天天气好。
天空中飘着几朵云，但阳光灿烂。
琼斯先生同他的家人在一起。
他们正在过桥。
河上有几艘船。
琼斯先生和他的妻子正在看这些船。
莎莉正在观看一艘大船。
那船正从桥下驶过。
蒂姆正望着一架飞机。
飞机正从河上飞过。

lines.en: There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.
They are walking over the bridge.
There are some boats on the river.
Mr Jones and his wife are looking at them.
Sally is looking at a big ship.
The ship is going under the bridge.
Tim is looking at an airplane.
The airplane is flying over the river.

lead.summary: 今天天气好。 天空中飘着几朵云，但阳光灿烂。语法聚焦：some clouds，几朵云。。
lead.tips: 语法重点：some clouds，几朵云。。重点词汇：day、cloud、sky 等，结合课文例句记忆。练法：先盲听跟读，再对照参考译文理解，最后尝试复述课文。
lead.question: Where is the Jones family? 琼斯一家人在哪里？
